structured_output.summary: The leftover duplicate was the private `steerTo` helper in tests/sim/rival-pickup-block.test.ts. It re-implemented the existing `driveToward` in tests/sim/helpers.ts: heading toward a point (atan2(dx, -dz) = headingOf), wrap the error into ±π, multiply by 2.5 and clamp to [-1, 1]. That file is new in this PR, not an existing test on main, so the earlier reason for not fixing it was wrong. I deleted `steerTo` and car 0's approach now uses `driveToward(world, box.x, box.z).steer`, imported from ./helpers.ts. The diff only touches that new test file. Behaviour is unchanged: the AC4 test still passes, `pnpm typecheck` is clean, and `pnpm test` passes 134/142 files. The 8 files that failed were browser/UI and one game test (best-lap-persistence, countdown-clear-browser, desktop-hud-scale, desktop-start-screen, hud-motion-reduced, keycap-legend-resize, keycap-legend-slide, track-card-press). None touch this code, and all 8 pass when rerun on their own, so they look like timing flakes under full-suite load. This is a duplication fix, so there is no new red/green test.
